title: The Doctor Who Used HIV-Infected Blood as 'Immunity Booster'
hook: He told patients a single injection would make them immune to all diseases — it was HIV-positive blood.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines medical betrayal with body horror — viewers will be shocked that a doctor intentionally infected patients.

title: The FDA-Approved Nasal Spray That Dissolved Nasal Cartilage
hook: It was meant to clear sinuses — instead it ate away the bridge of patients' noses.
why_this_can_go_viral: Visceral body horror combined with FDA failure — people love stories about approved products causing bizarre harm.

title: The Hospital That Burned Patients Alive in 'Experimental Radiation Beds'
hook: They were marketed as therapeutic warmth machines — but they slowly cooked patients from the inside.
why_this_can_go_viral: Feels like a horror movie but real — the slow-burn death detail is unforgettable and shareable.

title: The Surgeon Who Deliberately Left Sponges Inside Patients — For Years
hook: He wasn't careless — he was testing if the body would reject foreign objects. Patients rotted from within.
why_this_can_go_viral: Twists the familiar 'doctor forgot sponge' story into something far more sinister and intentional.

title: The Supplement That Claimed to 'Detox' You — But Gave You Organ Failure
hook: It was marketed as a natural cleanse — inside was a chemical that shut down kidneys in 48 hours.
why_this_can_go_viral: Taps into the massive supplement market — viewers will question everything they buy at health stores.

title: The Disease Cover-Up: They Knew the Factory Smoke Gave Children Brain Tumors
hook: For 30 years, the company paid doctors to call it 'a cluster of bad luck' — while kids died.
why_this_can_go_viral: The innocence of children + corporate evil = massive emotional impact. Reminds people of Flint water crisis.

title: The Dentist Who Reused Syringes — Infecting Hundreds with Hepatitis
hook: He cleaned them with tap water and called it sterile. Patients thought they got flu — it was liver failure.
why_this_can_go_viral: Relatable fear of dental visits + disgust at reused equipment — easy to trigger share reflex.

title: The Pharmaceutical Company That Sold 'Antibiotics' — Filled with Glass Dust
hook: Patients complained of throat cuts — the company said it was 'just a texture issue' and kept selling.
why_this_can_go_viral: The casual corporate denial ('just a texture') is infuriating and meme-worthy.

title: The Doctor Who Screwed Metal Plates into Patients' Skulls — Without Anesthesia
hook: He claimed the procedure was 'painless' because he believed the brain didn't feel pain. He was wrong.
why_this_can_go_viral: Extreme gore factor + moral outrage. The image of screws going into a conscious skull is unforgettable.

title: The Hospital That Painted Over Mold in Operating Rooms — Patients Died of Sepsis
hook: The mold was growing on the ceiling above open incisions. Administrators just painted it white.
why_this_can_go_viral: The absurdity of painting over mold is both hilarious and horrifying — perfect for viral disgust.

hook: It promised explosive muscle growth. Inside was crushed rodent skeleton and floor sweepings.
why_this_can_go_viral: Gym culture + disgust = viral. Bodybuilders will share in horror. The visual of ground rat bones is strong.

title: The Disease Cover-Up: They Knew the Vaccine Caused Paralysis — and Hid It for a Decade
hook: Children went to bed healthy and woke up unable to move. The company called it 'coincidence.'
why_this_can_go_viral: Vaccine controversies are evergreen. This adds a concrete, horrifying case that drives engagement on all sides.

title: The Doctor Who Injected Patients with Battery Acid — and Called It 'Joint Lubricant'
hook: He told arthritis patients their joints needed 'electrical reactivation.' The acid ate their cartilage away.
why_this_can_go_viral: Battery acid + joints = instant visceral reaction. The pseudoscientific excuse is infuriating and shareable.

title: The Pharmaceutical Company That Sold a 'Cough Syrup' — That Was 100% Opioid Syrup
hook: It wasn't contaminated — the entire bottle was a liquid narcotic. They marketed it for children's coughs.
why_this_can_go_viral: Children + opioids = maximum outrage. The sheer irresponsibility is mind-blowing and highly shareable.

title: The Hospital That Stored Organs in a Broken Freezer — and Transplanted Them Anyway
hook: The organs were rotting, but the hospital said 'they were still viable.' Recipients died within days.
why_this_can_go_viral: Transplant stories are inherently emotional. The idea of knowingly using rotten organs is unthinkable.

hook: Women applied it daily for a 'radiant complexion.' It was giving them mesothelioma.
why_this_can_go_viral: Beauty products + cancer = nightmare fuel for millions of women. High emotional relevance.

hook: He told patients they had 'growths' that needed removal. The growths were perfectly healthy kidneys.
why_this_can_go_viral: The ultimate violation — waking up to find a healthy organ missing. Organ trafficking is a high-interest topic.

title: The FDA-Approved Migraine Drug That Caused Aneurysms
hook: It stopped headaches by constricting blood vessels — so hard that they burst inside the brain.
why_this_can_go_viral: Migraine sufferers are a huge audience. The mechanism is easy to visualize and terrifying.

hook: They wanted to study the incubation period — so they injected rabies directly into human brains.
why_this_can_go_viral: Rabies is 99.9% fatal and universally feared. The idea of intentionally injecting it is pure horror.

hook: Construction workers were told the dust was 'harmless.' Their lungs turned into scar tissue.
why_this_can_go_viral: Blue-collar betrayal story resonates with millions. The slow suffocation detail is haunting.

title: The Doctor Who Told Patients They Had Cancer — to Bill Them for Chemo
hook: He faked biopsy results and pumped healthy people with poison. Some actually developed cancer from the drugs.
why_this_can_go_viral: The cruelest financial scam imaginable — faking cancer to sell chemo. Ultimate trust betrayal.

title: The Pharmaceutical Company That Put Cyanide in Cold Medicine — by Accident
hook: A factory mix-up contaminated millions of bottles. The company found out — and shipped them anyway.
why_this_can_go_viral: Cyanide in everyday medicine is a universal fear. The deliberate shipment makes it evil.
